checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Man centred, face fully visible during question
must.why: Man is left of centre, not centred; the face is visible but the frame is not reframed.

must.item: Woman centred, face fully visible during answer
must.why: Woman stays at the right edge, partly cropped at times.

must.item: Turns in original order, full 10 s, original audio in sync
must.why: Duration is 10 s with sound, but the AI regenerated the footage and the content looks different; sync can't be judged.
No captions visible and no obvious stretching.

faults.what: No reframing to centre the speakers; the man and woman stay at the left and right edges.
The AI regenerated the footage: the faces differ from the original (the woman's face and the dark-shirted man's expression changed), so the content is no longer the user's original clip.
Softer, lower-resolution look from the 480p regeneration.

summary: The output is a regenerated landscape 832x448 clip with no vertical crop and no speaker centring, and the faces have changed, so it misses the request.
